sara-p: quick heads-up — noticed a cluster of accounts reclassed to RED health overnight after the latest decay tweak. large jump in renewal_risk_flagged. :frowning:

maria-g: saw it too on the weekly dashboard. a lot of these accounts have only a single low-activity ping in the last 48h so the current decay is too aggressive.

tim-o: agree. the half-life we picked (3d) was probably too short for product engagement signals. proposal: smooth scores using EWMA with a longer effective window and a minimum floor for accounts with recent activity.

rachel-cs: we need to be careful — CS playbooks auto-schedule outreach on RED. last thing we want is a surge of renewal nudges to accounts that are actually fine. Can we add a safelist so playbooks won't trigger on transient drops for enterprise/high-touch accounts?

sara-p: absolutely. my proposal: two changes — 1) change decay math to EWMA alpha=0.12 (approx 7d half-life) and a floor that retains at least 60% of baseline for accounts with activity in last 14 days; 2) playbook gating: require health_delta to persist for 7d before automated playbooks run for premium tiers.

tim-o: implementation notes: will add a feature flag `cs.healthsmoother.v1` with modes `observe|soft|enforce`. in observe mode we only emit old vs new score diffs so CS can validate. also add telemetry tags `healthsmoother_mode` and `smoother_reason` to events.

sara-p: good. add instrumentation for these metrics: `health_regrade_rate`, `health_regrade_persistent_7d`, `renewal_playbook_triggers`. alert if `health_regrade_rate` > 0.15% per hour during rollout.

rachel-cs: timeline? CS needs time to prepare playbook schedules and manual outreach scripts if needed.

sara-p: rollout suggestion: today observe for 4h on 5% sample (random by account_id mod 20), then soft for 48h on 20% if metrics stable, then enforce next week.

ops-bot: deploy requested by tim-o: branch `healthscore/smoother` -> staging. CI passed. :robot_face:

tim-o: SQL backfill plan (small, idempotent) to recompute scores for last 30 days for the 5% sample. will run as a job with low priority. sample query:

```
-- recompute EWMA healthscore for account subset
WITH seeds AS (
  SELECT account_id, activity_ts, activity_signal
  FROM account_activity
  WHERE account_id % 20 = 3 AND activity_ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
)
UPDATE account_health ah
SET score = sub.new_score
FROM (
  SELECT s.account_id, compute_ewma(s.account_id) as new_score
  FROM seeds s
  GROUP BY s.account_id
) sub
WHERE ah.account_id = sub.account_id;
```

(Note: `compute_ewma` is a stored fn we will update to use alpha=0.12).

maria-g: will watch the dashboard during the observe window and fetch delta snapshots every 30m. sharing our Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/health/score-deltas

rachel-cs: CS comms draft for internal leads:
```
Heads up: We're adjusting healthscore smoothing to reduce noisy renewals. During soft rollout some accounts may see delayed automated outreach; CS leads will get a list of affected accounts daily. Contact CS Ops if you see a customer that needs immediate help.
```

sara-p: added an emergency rollback runbook: flip `cs.healthsmoother.v1` to `off` in LaunchDarkly, run an immediate backfill job to restore prior scores from snapshot table `healthscore_snapshots`, and notify #incidents. owner: sara-p. SLA: revert within 15m.

tim-o: I'll add a migration to add `healthscore_baseline` and index `idx_health_last_activity` to avoid table scans. PR includes tests and the LD flag wiring.

ops-bot: staging deploy successful for `healthscore/smoother` at 2024-06-20T09:42:10Z. CI run id: 123321.

maria-g: starting observe mode now on 5% sample. will post snapshots at +30m and +4h. if `health_regrade_rate` > 0.15% we abort. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

rachel-cs: thanks — CS leads looped in. will prepare manual outreach templates just in case.

sara-p: thanks everyone. let's reconvene after the 4h window in this thread and decide next steps. :white_check_mark:
